title: Build a Relational Database
prompt: Design library tables for books, authors, members and loans. Model many-to-many authorship and report active/overdue loans.
objective: Apply the SQLite concepts in build a relational database and produce verifiable evidence.

starter.code:
-- Practice task: Build a Relational Database
-- Use a disposable database; record expected output before execution.

expected_output: Referential integrity is maintained and the report outputs match the fixture.
acceptance_criteria: Addresses every explicit requirement in the task: Design library tables for books, authors, members and loans. Model many-to-many authorship and report active/overdue loans.
Referential integrity is maintained and the report outputs match the fixture.
Documents setup/runtime assumptions and one failure or boundary case.
hints: Start with a tiny known dataset; write the intended schema and expected rows first.
Run one statement at a time and inspect the schema and result values.
Use the official SQLite reference and verify optional feature support before debugging application logic.
grading_method: Server-side source-string checks are only a minimal rubric and do not execute arbitrary SQL. Verify SQL in a local SQLite CLI/API; performance, recovery and architecture tasks require human review.
retry_policy: Retries are allowed. Incorrect submissions award no XP; completion/reward idempotency remains backend-owned.
status_note: Unreviewed curriculum draft; human review and a local feature/version check are required before publication.
